title: content-10: enforce §3.3 senderUri/roomUri match on every receive path
description: draft-ietf-mimi-content-10 §3.3 makes a present senderUri (ext 1) or roomUri (ext 2) that differs from the enclosing protocol's authenticated sender/room URI a MUST reject (§9.1: log and discard). mimid checks this only in ReceivedFrank::verify (crates/mimi-protocol/src/frank.rs:398-403) and abuse-report verification (abuse.rs:107-110); mimi-content defers it to the caller (lib.rs:20-24). Any receive path that decodes MimiContent without franking verification (future mimid-agent client, mimid-1wgh.13) must compare present extensions byte-exact (decision 5.58) against the authenticated LeafNode sender URI and the room URI and reject on mismatch; absent extensions are allowed. Note -10 gives no comparison rule (byte-exact vs RFC 3986 §6), a possible WG finding.
acceptance_criteria: Test: mismatching senderUri/roomUri rejected, absent extensions accepted, using an independent fixture (not mimid's own encoder as oracle).
close_reason: Existing receive paths enforce content-10 §3.3 (byte-exact, decision .5.58): franking verify (mimi-protocol tests/franking_integrity.rs receiver_rejects_sender_mismatch, receiver_rejects_room_mismatch) and hub abuse reports (new mimid-server tests/hub_abuse.rs content_uri_extensions_must_match_the_enclosing_protocol: hand-encoded content franked as sent; matching accepted, mismatched senderUri/roomUri refused). Documented in mimi-content lib.rs Limitations; the agent path is handed to mimid-1wgh.13 as an acceptance criterion.
